critical_limitation_found: The 手順2 (Howell unit-pivot elimination modulo M) method, applied to N_source ALONE (the pre-selected 62x60 matrix using a FIXED set of 60 ambient columns from one large-prime pivot certificate), can only give a CONCLUSIVE result when it returns success (proves p does not divide d_r-prime for every p|M simultaneously). When it returns insufficient, that is INCONCLUSIVE, not evidence of a genuine rank drop in the full map -- this was verified directly: the primes 2 and 5, which stages.T5 of v1.2 already CONFIRMED innocent via the full rank_nu_j_on_subspace_ambient computation (rank_p=60=r_prime for both), were RE-DERIVED as free factors during the split process here and BOTH independently gave insufficient_order_independent (8/8 trials) when tested via the Howell method on N_source alone -- i.e. this method would have (wrongly, if trusted blindly) flagged already-known-innocent primes as unresolved. N_source is a FIXED 60-column subset of a much larger target space (dim t_11 Lyndon coords = 16290, or ambient words = 179195); a fixed column subset can be singular mod a specific prime even when the FULL map has full rank there. Conclusion: the 71-digit final residual reported as insufficient_order_independent below is THEREFORE ALSO INCONCLUSIVE (not evidence of real torsion) by the same logic that made the 2,5 case inconclusive -- it does NOT independently establish a genuine rank drop, contrary to the initial framing in stages.step2_howell_mod_M.closures. Closing this residual conclusively would need EITHER identifying its actual prime factors (computational number theory beyond what is available here) OR redoing the Howell elimination against a WIDER column set (not just N_source's fixed 60) so that alternate pivot columns are available when one set is singular mod a given prime -- this second escalation was NOT attempted in this run (reported to 司令塔 for direction).
